interpretation: Specialist playbooks describe field-wide work; included Python engines implement particular local operations. Additional host tools require their own setup and permission.

roles.scope: Coordinates multi-step goals across specialists, defining dependencies, owner decisions, resource limits, interruption recovery and independent acceptance.
real_work: Plan scoped task graphs and approval gates
Recover interrupted tasks without replaying uncertain effects
Review evidence and handoffs against acceptance criteria
roles.engine_note: Local planning, evidence and review functions. No live worker dispatch is included.

roles.scope: Builds, debugs and validates maintainable software from real source, including implementation, repair, regression testing, source custody and release readiness.
real_work: Reproduce a failing case before changing code
Implement reviewed repairs and verify regression behavior
Review source provenance, gated execution and recovery evidence
roles.engine_note: Claim Gate has local executable code and tests. Iron Ledger consumer and Provenance Vault are evidence-only source candidates with separate redistribution and native-host qualifications.

roles.scope: Develops learned models and adapters through dataset design, training plans, bounded model experiments, held-out evaluation and artifact provenance.
real_work: Partition datasets and qualify training plans
Run small local model training and inspect weights and metrics
Compare candidates and preserve reproducible model artifacts
roles.engine_note: Bundled local toy-model training and evaluation are not a hosted GPU or general-purpose fine-tuning service.

roles.scope: Designs and critiques research, checks primary evidence, tests competing explanations and measures candidate claims with held-out, reproducible evaluation.
real_work: Verify quotations and exact source locations
Check source-family separation and held-out scoring
Compare hypotheses, controls and counterexamples
roles.engine_note: Local evidence and numerical checks are not independent publisher authentication or scientific truth.

roles.scope: Develops original images, animation, video and interactive experiences with art direction, asset development, scene planning, production review, continuity and delivery.
real_work: Establish style, story, asset and interaction direction
Plan shots, timing, animation and media dependencies
Review real render outputs and preserve rights and continuity
roles.engine_note: The packaged engine builds plans, timelines and textual storyboards. Actual image/video rendering uses separately available host tools.

roles.scope: Tests authorized systems, software releases and permission boundaries with threat modeling, negative controls, failure reproduction and remediation verification.
real_work: Define a bounded defensive test plan and stop conditions
Challenge failure and authorization boundaries with approved host tools
Record reproducible findings and independently verify fixes
roles.engine_note: Public V1 provides this specialist's methods and configuration, not an independent executable security testing service.

roles.scope: Helps with private daily organization, personalized planning, routines, accessibility preferences and consent-aware household and life workflows.
real_work: Organize and edit saved tasks and notes
Preserve preferences and recover interrupted work
Plan routines and actions with explicit owner permissions
roles.engine_note: Daily Desk is a functioning local SQLite workbench. Calendar, messaging and native reminders require separately supported integrations.

roles.scope: Manages plant records, gardening observations, evidence-aware care guidance and seasonal projects with owner-controlled schedules.
real_work: Record plant observations and uncertainties
Prepare seasonal planting and maintenance plans
Track local schedule revisions and care histories
roles.engine_note: Local observations and calendar records do not assert live external calendar synchronization or plant diagnosis.

roles.scope: Builds study and learning experiences from supplied material: lesson plans, flashcards, practice, feedback, mastery checks and spaced review.
real_work: Ground lessons and flashcards in supplied sources
Run scored practice and explain misconceptions
Track review records and adapt the next session
roles.engine_note: Local scoring and review records do not replace professional certification or independently confirm mastery.

roles.scope: Evaluates contested technical and factual claims against original evidence, preserving provenance, uncertainty, revision history and defensible conclusions.
real_work: Bind claims to exact evidence and source revisions
Test whether cited results support the claimed conclusion
Record qualified verdicts and correction histories
roles.engine_note: Source-bound reviews are not an independently authenticated legal or scientific ruling.

roles.scope: Investigates authorized software behavior, application structure, protocols and defensive artifacts using observations and controlled clean-room analysis.
real_work: Compare recorded application behavior and protocol observations
Reconstruct bounded behavioral contracts from approved samples
Inspect security-related findings without unapproved live probing
roles.engine_note: The included executable analyzes supplied observations; no live capture or unapproved target access is bundled.

roles.scope: Designs trustworthy data flows and databases, including schema evolution, identity and quality checks, event reconciliation, query access and migration planning.
real_work: Profile supplied data, keys and missing values
Review schema changes and reconcile versioned events
Classify supplied query plans and surface migration risks
roles.engine_note: The source collection provides schema, event and query tools; live databases require explicit connections and authority.

roles.scope: Analyzes service health, reliability objectives, capacity, incident response and recovery evidence to support operational decisions.
real_work: Compute SLO/error-budget use from supplied events
Estimate capacity with explicit assumptions
Reconcile incident timelines and verify recovery evidence
roles.engine_note: Local reliability calculations use supplied metrics and do not mutate production services.

roles.scope: Designs multi-stage automations, connector workflows and permission-aware execution with dependency planning, retries, idempotency and effect reconciliation.
real_work: Validate workflow DAGs, prerequisites and approvals
Review locator selection and idempotency contracts
Reconcile observed effects and interrupted runs
roles.engine_note: The included local engine checks plans and effect records; no live scheduler or service write occurs without a host integration.

roles.scope: Designs product experiences spanning research, layout, interaction states, responsive behavior, accessibility and build-ready handoff.
real_work: Map user journeys, requirements and design states
Check color contrast and declared interface-state coverage
Review labels, feedback and accessibility requirements
roles.engine_note: The included engine evaluates declared state and color inputs; rendered UI and usability reviews require real browser or human evidence.
